items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: I think Woody Herman came in, and then there was a whole slew, Teddy Powell, and even Red Nichols.

ctx.x: I don't know. I really don't. I think that I could have gotten away with it. Because I think those guys that ran that place, I mean if you were doing business

and the band was good, I don't think they cared. As long as the people were coming in. But as far as, you know, consorting with people that were working there, they took a dim view of that. This was before they had the big bands. This was the time like when the Louis Prima band was playing in there. This was before they went to the large bands in there.
